, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a pretty flower. The flower was sad because it wanted to bloom and be tall like the mountains.
One day, a bird came to the mountain. The bird saw the sad flower and wanted to help. The bird had an idea. The bird told the flower to wait and watch.
The bird sat on the mountain and waited. After some time, the bird started to bloom. The bird was so happy! The mountain became a happy place for all the flowers. And the bird and the flower became good friends, playing in the big mountain together.
